verdict.rationale: Moneybird publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 document in its official GitHub organization. The reference pages link to it via a "Download OpenAPI Specification" control, and the reference and changelog are both generated from the spec. The probe's 404s on conventional developer-site paths reflect discoverability, not absence, so they do not dispute the GitHub-hosted spec. Missing for 10: the spec is not served at a conventional well-known path (e.g., /openapi.json) on the developer domain.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
